servers.name: Filesystem
servers.description: Read/write access to a restricted set of directories. The default argument (".") allows the dsh working directory — edit the row to list the roots you want to expose.
servers.descriptionZh: 受控目录的读写访问。默认参数 "." 只放开 dsh 工作目录，安装后可编辑该行，列出你要开放的具体目录。

servers.name: Memory
servers.description: Persistent knowledge-graph memory across sessions (entities, relations, observations).
servers.descriptionZh: 跨会话的持久知识图谱记忆（实体、关系、观察）。

servers.name: Sequential Thinking
servers.description: Dynamic, reflective problem-solving through structured chains of thought.
servers.descriptionZh: 通过结构化的思考链进行动态、反思式的问题求解。

servers.name: Everything
servers.description: Reference server exercising every MCP feature — prompts, resources, tools, sampling. Handy for verifying a client setup.
servers.descriptionZh: 覆盖 MCP 全部能力的参考服务器——提示、资源、工具、采样，适合验证客户端配置。

servers.name: Git
servers.description: Operations on local Git repositories: status, diff, branches, commits, tags.
servers.descriptionZh: 操作本地 Git 仓库：状态、差异、分支、提交、标签。

servers.name: Fetch
servers.description: Web content fetching and conversion, optimized for LLM usage.
servers.descriptionZh: 网页内容抓取与转换，面向 LLM 使用优化。

servers.name: SQLite
servers.description: SQLite database access with schema inspection and query analysis. Edit the row's --db-path argument after installing.
servers.descriptionZh: SQLite 数据库访问，支持结构检查与查询分析。安装后可编辑该行的 --db-path 参数。

servers.name: Time
servers.descriptionZh: 当前时间查询与时区转换。

servers.name: GitHub
servers.description: Repositories, issues, PRs, and more. Requires a personal access token in the environment after install.
servers.descriptionZh: 仓库、Issue、PR 等操作。安装后需在环境变量中填入个人访问令牌。

servers.name: Brave Search
servers.description: Web/local/image/news search via the Brave API. Requires a Brave API key.
servers.descriptionZh: 通过 Brave API 进行网页/本地/图片/新闻搜索，需要 Brave API 密钥。

servers.name: Puppeteer
servers.description: Browser automation: navigation, screenshots, clicks, form fills, JS evaluation.
servers.descriptionZh: 浏览器自动化：导航、截图、点击、表单填写、JS 执行。

servers.name: Context7
servers.description: Up-to-date, version-specific documentation and code examples for libraries and frameworks.
servers.descriptionZh: 获取各类库与框架的最新版本文档与代码示例。
